title: The Tamed Subgradient Unadjusted Langevin Algorithm beyond Convexity
abstract: arXiv:2608.06283v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study the problem of sampling from target distributions whose potentials are simultaneously non-smooth, subject to superlinear gradient growth, and non-convex. We introduce the Subgradient Tamed Unadjusted Langevin Algorithm (SG-TULA), a discretisation of the Langevin diffusion that operates directly on subgradients, without relying on computationally demanding smoothing procedures. To handle the superlinear regime, taming techniques are employed to produce a stable, explicit scheme. We derive non-asymptotic convergence bounds in Wasserstein-2 distance, with all constants tracked explicitly in terms of dimension and inverse temperature, improving upon the currently known rates for subgradient-based Langevin algorithms. We further provide excess risk estimates for the associated optimisation problem. translated_title: 超越凸性情形的驯服次梯度未调整朗之万算法
translated_abstract: 我们研究从目标分布中进行采样的问�题，其中目标分布的势函数同时具有非光滑、梯度超线性增长以及非凸的特性。我们提出了次梯度驯服未调整朗之万算法（SG-TULA），这是朗之万扩散的一种离散化格式，直接作用于次梯度，无需依赖计算代价高昂的光滑化处理。为应对超线性增长的情形，我们采用驯服技术构建出稳定且显式的计算格式。我们在 Wasserstein-2 距离下推导出非渐近收敛界，所有常数均以维度和逆温度显式给出，改进了目前已知的基于次梯度的朗之万算法的收敛速率。我们还为相关优化问题提供了超额风险估计。我们以显式常数验证了相关假设对于 GPT-2 系大语言模型的正则化预训练势函数成立，并且……
tldr: 提出 SG-TULA 算法，直接利用次梯度实现对非光滑、非凸且梯度超线性增长目标分布的稳定采样，给出了显式常数的 Wasserstein-2 非渐近收敛界与优化超额风险估计，并可应用于 GPT-2 类大模型的预训练势函数。
en_tdlr: We propose SG-TULA, a tamed subgradient-based Langevin sampling algorithm for non-smooth, non-convex potentials with superlinear gradient growth, providing explicit non-asymptotic Wasserstein-2 convergence bounds and excess risk guarantees, validated on GPT-2-style LLM pretraining potentials.
